briefdescription.para: Opcode of the update operation, currently either add or sub.

memberdef.argsstring: (unsigned Opcode, iterator_range< IterT > Operands, DebugLoc DL={})
memberdef.name: VPHistogramRecipe

briefdescription.para: Return the cost of this VPHistogramRecipe.
Return the mask operand if one was provided, or a null pointer if all lanes should be executed unconditionally.
A recipe representing a sequence of load -> update -> store as part of a histogram operation.

detaileddescription.para: This means there may be aliasing between vector lanes, which is handled by the llvm.experimental.vector.histogram family of intrinsics. The only update operations currently supported are 'add' and 'sub' where the other term is loop-invariant.
